title: Phase v2-S relevance matcher as an O(N) admission router in front of a capacity-limited exact store
verdict: UNSUPPORTED — the Phase matcher never beats the simple COND baseline in any capacity regime
frozen_constraints: V2-S recurrence S_t=S_{t-1}+B_t(k*v), gamma=1, omega=0, one bank, existing readout, validated matcher; NO dynamic decay/rotation/C_t/multibank/hard-eviction/quadratic

design.identities: (entity, relation) composite; relevance requires joint match
design.exact_store: capacity K, oracle composite-identity binding, latest-wins, exact lookup/hop-chain; no neural decoder, no unbounded fallback

saturation_gate_section11.note: single-hop saturated at COND everywhere; admitting one relevant event only needs it ranked #1, which a focus-conditioned gate does. Multi-hop is non-saturated (oracle 0.88-0.97) but unsolved by learnable routers.

multihop_N128_K8.note: both COND and Phase matcher fail transitive 2nd hop; bilinear <= COND; huge oracle gap unclosed

causal_controls_best_matcher_multihop.note: matcher signal is focus-dependent (collapses under controls) but smaller than COND and net-negative

cosine_vs_bilinear: cosine >= bilinear at tight capacity (0.69 vs 0.54 at N128_K4); retain cosine as lighter, but both < COND

acceptance_section16.1_task_capacity_bound_nonsaturated: FAIL single-hop (saturated at COND); multihop valid but unsolved

interpretation_section17: No explicit matcher beats COND-MLP -> per rule, move to contrastive focus-event representation learning. Study localizes the real headroom to multi-hop admission, a single-pass-routing limitation no relevance score fixes (needs iterative/bounded-quadratic retrieval).
next_permitted_step: Contrastive focus-event representation learning (last test vs COND). If it also fails, STOP Phase-as-admission-router / Phase-downstream research and keep V2-S as a standalone bounded associative memory. The multi-hop gap is a separate iterative/bounded-quadratic retrieval line, not Phase-recurrence work.
